description: He wears a dark grey-green crossed-front long coat with refined gold-brown geometric borders and subtle cloudlike woven motifs across the front. Pale cream sleeves and collar of an underlayer show beneath the short outer sleeves. A brown patterned sash with fringe and small metal fittings wraps the waist. Dark patterned leather-like forearm wraps cover the lower sleeves. Brown trousers and tall dark brown decorated boots are fully visible. The garment is opaque and textured; exact fiber cannot be confirmed. No weapons, headgear or hard body armor are visible.
